# Timetable {#sec-timetable .unnumbered}

The course is made of 12 sessions. Each session comprises 5 (teaching) units of 45 minutes. Following feedback from earlier years, each session spans over the lunch break. The preferred timing for each session is

**Monday 10:15 to 11:45 ; lunch break; 13:15 to 15:30**

with an additional 2 units for extended sessions from **15.45 to 17.15**

Lunch break time may however vary a little based on contents and progress. We have attempted to balance theoretical explanations and R practice within each session.

The 2026-2027 schedule is set as follows. Please refer to your *student guichet* and your emails (potentially sent through *Moodle*) for potential changes during the semester.

- 28 Sept
